title: Understanding Counterspeech for Online Harm Mitigation

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic literature review of counterspeech datasets and social/computational intervention strategies evaluating effectiveness against Islamophobia and religious extremism.
Systematic literature review of counterspeech datasets and intervention methodologies evaluating effectiveness against racism and anti-Asian prejudice.
Systematic literature review analyzing counterspeech effectiveness and sentiment analysis against xenophobia and hate speech targeting immigrants.
Systematic literature review examining the extent of counterspeech studies addressing hate speech targeted at the LGBTQ+ community.
Systematic literature review exploring counterspeech generation and interventions addressing misogyny and subtle abuse against women, such as microaggressions.
